title: 2.1.9 Make it Move
description: Drive a sprite with the arrow keys by setting vel.x and vel.y based on what's pressed.

steps.title: Set up a sprite in an empty world
steps.instructions: Make a 400×400 canvas, set `world.gravity.y = 0` (no falling), and create a dynamic sprite in the middle.
hints: Gravity off keeps the sprite where you put it until you move it yourself.

steps.title: Horizontal movement
steps.instructions: In update(), if kb.pressing('left') set player.vel.x = -4; else if kb.pressing('right') set +4; else set it to 0.
hints: vel.x is pixels per frame. Positive = right, negative = left.

steps.title: Vertical movement
steps.instructions: Same pattern with 'up' / 'down' on player.vel.y. Remember: in screen coords, up is negative y.
hints: Always reset vel.y to 0 in the else branch or the sprite will coast forever.

steps.title: Clear the background
steps.instructions: Call background('...') in draw() so old frames don't stack.

requirements.title: Horizontal keyboard input
requirements.description: Use kb.pressing('left') or kb.pressing('right') inside update() or draw()

requirements.title: Vertical keyboard input
requirements.description: Use kb.pressing('up') or kb.pressing('down') inside update() or draw()

requirements.title: Set horizontal velocity
requirements.description: Assign to a sprite's vel.x inside update() or draw()

requirements.title: Set vertical velocity
requirements.description: Assign to a sprite's vel.y inside update() or draw()
